I replied in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025.

- **Sources:** Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own Dec 8 cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.
- **Operational date:** Her recap says she kept running the account day to day through Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if the tracker needs the operational start date instead.
